headline.purpose: The home screen's 'Hi there' greeting only — the single large text moment in the system.

title.purpose: Header org/agent name, paired with the avatar and status row.

body.purpose: Message bubble text and form input text — real content the visitor reads or writes.

label.purpose: Form field labels, button text, status text.

caption.purpose: Timestamps, privacy line, optional-field suffix — the quietest text.

shadows.name: panel-float
shadows.purpose: The whole panel floating above the host page.

shadows.name: launcher-float
shadows.purpose: Brand-tinted glow under the launcher button.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft brand-tinted glow under the one primary action per screen (CTA, send button).

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Loading-skeleton bubble pulse while chat history fetches; staggered ~0.12s per row.

motion.name: typing-bounce
motion.purpose: The (currently unwired) typing-indicator dots' bounce, staggered 0.15s per dot.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width the panel becomes a full-screen overlay instead of a floating card.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled, high-emphasis action per screen — 'Start a conversation', 'Start chat'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #fff; font: 600 14.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 13px 16px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06), 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(37,99,235,.4); transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Secondary Card
components.description: A substantial secondary choice, e.g. 'Continue previous conversation' — bordered, not filled.
components.css: .ds-outline-card { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; padding: 13px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-outline-card:hover { background: #f7f8fa; } .ds-outline-card-title { font: 600 13.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #101828; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Sunk-background input that lifts to white with a brand focus ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font: 600 12.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #344054; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: #f7f8fa; font: 400 13.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #101828; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #667085; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2563eb; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,.14); }

components.name: Message Bubble — Visitor (inbound)
components.description: The visitor's own message, right-aligned, light brand tint (not solid fill).
components.html: We're on the Team plan, billed annually.
components.css: .ds-bubble-row { display: flex; } .ds-bubble-row--inbound { justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-bubble { max-width: 82%; padding: 10px 13px; border-radius: 14px; font: 400 13.5px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-bubble--inbound { background: color-mix(in srgb, #2563eb 14%, white); color: #101828; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Message Bubble — Admin (outbound)
components.description: The admin/agent reply, left-aligned, white with a hairline border.
components.html: Can you tell me which plan your workspace is on?
components.css: .ds-bubble-row--outbound { justify-content: flex-start; } .ds-bubble--outbound { max-width: 82%; padding: 10px 13px; border-radius: 14px; font: 400 13.5px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; background: #fff; color: #101828; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Launcher
components.description: The collapsed circular entry point, floating bottom-corner of the host page.
components.html: <button class="ds-launcher" aria-label="Open chat"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" width="26" height="26"><path d="M21 11.5a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9 3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1-7.6 4.7 8.38 8.38 0 0 1-3.8-.9L3 21l1.9-5.7a8.38 8.38 0 0 1-.9-3.8 8.5 8.5 0 0 1 4.7-7.6 8.38 8.38 0 0 1 3.8-.9h.5a8.48 8.48 0 0 1 8 8v.5z" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-launcher { width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #2563eb; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -4px rgba(37,99,235,.45), 0 4px 10px rgba(16,24,40,.12); } .ds-launcher:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: Pill text input plus a circular brand-fill send button — unique to the composer, not reused elsewhere.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-composer-input-wrap { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; background: #f7f8fa; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 22px; padding: 0 14px; } .ds-composer-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #2563eb; background: #fff; } .ds-composer-input { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; padding: 10px 0; font: 400 13.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #101828; } .ds-composer-input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: #667085; } .ds-composer-send { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #2563eb; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -1px rgba(37,99,235,.45); }

narrative.overview:
This is a support panel that behaves the way a good concierge does: present, competent, and almost entirely out of the way until you need it. The system is deliberately restrained — one accent color, a fixed neutral scale, no gradients, no decorative iconography, no invented metrics or urgency devices. It reads as a real SaaS product (the register named in the brief was Intercom/Crisp/Tidio-tier), not a generic AI-generated dashboard: soft layered shadows instead of hard edges, a single system font stack at a small number of disciplined sizes, and generous but tight spacing rather than airy marketing whitespace.

The brand accent (--kw-primary-color, org-themeable) is rationed on purpose: it appears at the launcher, the one primary call-to-action per screen, the online-status accent, focus rings, and a light tint on the visitor's own messages. Every other surface — panel, header, form fields, admin messages — stays neutral slate and white. This scarcity is the point: when blue appears, it means "act here."
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, rationed to launcher / primary CTA / focus rings / online accent / visitor-message tint
Fixed neutral scale (slate grays + white), never themed per org
Soft, ambient shadows — never a hard/flat neobrutalist edge, never a heavy card-stack
A single system font stack, disciplined into five size/weight roles, no display type
Every interactive control has a visible focus ring in the accent color

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The brand accent marks exactly one thing per screen: the single primary action. A screen never has two blue CTAs competing for attention.

rules.name: The Ink-400-Is-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: #98a2b3 exists for icon strokes and borders only. If a designer reaches for it on a text node, that's the contrast bug reintroducing itself.

rules.name: The No-Display-Face Rule
rules.body: This system has no display/hero typography role. The widget is 368px wide and task-focused; a large expressive headline would fight the concierge, not billboard premise.

rules.name: The Flat-Interior Rule
rules.body: Nothing inside the panel casts a shadow on anything else inside the panel. Elevation exists only at the panel/launcher's boundary with the host page, and on the one primary action per screen.

dos: Do ration the brand accent to one primary action, the launcher, focus rings, the online-status accent, and the visitor's-own-message tint — never more.
Do use Ink 500 (#667085) for any secondary or small text; it's the darkest neutral that still clears 4.5:1 contrast on white.
Do keep the panel interior flat — borders and background-tone shifts carry hierarchy, not shadows, inside the panel.
Do keep the header identical across every view; a view-specific header is a system violation, not a variant.
Do use the system font stack (-apple-system, ...) — no webfont, matching this repo's zero-runtime-dependency rule for the shipped widget.
donts: Don't use Ink 400 (#98a2b3) for text of any kind — icon strokes and borders only.
Don't add a second filled/brand-colored button on the same screen as the primary CTA.
Don't invent an unread-count number on the launcher badge — it's a boolean presence dot because no real count data exists in the store or API today. Wire real data first.
Don't add a functional-looking control (attachment icon, typing indicator, message reactions) that isn't actually wired to a real capability.
Don't give the visitor's own message bubbles a solid, fully-saturated brand fill by default — the light tint is the chosen treatment; solid fill is the legacy/fallback path only.
